description: We, the students of grade 5 participating in NASA space app challenge by creating a game which helps younger children to understand the necessary things for astronauts on space. We are doing this project with the help of our mentor Kavya S. Our team members are game developers, so we had chosen this challenge .
summary:
1. Project Name: Junior AMT – A Space-Themed Game.
2. Objective: To showcase our creativity, coding skills, and interest in space technology.
3. Platform Used: PictoBlox for developing the game.
4. Game Concept: The astronaut collects essential supplies needed to survive in space.
5. Main Supplies:

- Shields – Protect the astronaut.
- Life Support Systems – Help the astronaut survive in space.
- Food – Provides energy to the astronaut.

6. Keyboard Controls: The astronaut is controlled using the left and right arrow keys.
7. Sprite Interaction: Supplies are collected when the astronaut touches them.
8. Variables: Separate variables keep track of the collected supplies.
9. Coding Blocks: Motion, sensing, event, control, and variable blocks in PictoBlox.
10. AI and Design Tool: Canva was used for designing project-related visuals and presentation materials.
11. NASA Resources: NASA educational resources were used to learn about astronauts, space missions, life-support systems, and survival in space. https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/  https:/ NASA  Crew Systems/
details:
PictoBlox – Game development.

Block-based programming – Coding.

Sprites – Game characters and objects.

Keyboard controls – Player movement.

Variables – Supply tracking.

Canva – Graphic design and presentation.

Skills Learned: Coding, logical thinking, problem-solving, sprite management, and game development.

Project Outcome: Developed an interactive space-themed game combining science, technology, and creativity.
